# Default template for the SvelteKit framework adapter.
#
# Layout (added over time):
#   src/routes/                 SvelteKit file-based routes
#   src/lib/components/         Reusable components
#   src/lib/data/               Generated by `grove build-data`
#   static/                     Static assets
#   svelte.config.js
#   tailwind.config.mjs
#
# The CLI copies this directory verbatim into a new project
# via `grove new --framework svelte`. Pages and layouts live
# here; business logic lives in @grove-dev/core and
# @grove-dev/ui, and is imported into the template.
